independent_checks.summary_samples_order: lexicographic filenames; per-arm rows below use numeric label order

limitations: One diagnostic packet, with all 20 calls fixed in advance; no rerun or new workload executed by this reviewer.

ReadMemStats occurs before ResetTimer and after StopTimer; this changes surrounding GC/scheduler/cache state. Concurrent host/proc observation and pre-setup ELF copy/hash also perturb the process/host. It is not the original acceptance configuration.

Operation exports contain ordinal/type/duration, not actual operation start timestamps. No operation wall starts were reconstructed from accumulated durations, and no operation-to-GC/PSI alignment is claimed.

PauseTotalNs/PauseNs quantify recorded GC stop-the-world pauses, not concurrent marking, assist, all scheduler delay, or all runtime stop-the-world work. GCCPUFraction is cumulative since process startup; subtracting snapshots would not give interval GC CPU.

Whole-window host/cgroup pressure and process counters do not assign individual latency to a cause. PSI across ancestor cgroups overlaps and must not be added. Visible zero throttling is not proof about unavailable limits or the historical host.
Per-process endpoint counters cover only first-to-last in-window samples, not the complete window. Linux process CPU/fault/io counters and leader-thread context-switch counters have different scopes.
Normal command receipts prove leader joins and actual executable identities. They do not enumerate/reap adopted children on the normal path; exceptional group cleanup code was not exercised.

Root independently verified 124 internal artifact hashes, source/SDK identities and commands. This analysis consumes that separately hashed receipt; it did not independently validate external ZIP digest metadata.

Original 2588 M0 failed on a different CPU model (EPYC 9V74 versus this EPYC 7763). No comparable original GC/process/pressure observation exists here. CPU-model difference is a confound, not a demonstrated explanation.
